translated_title: The Roots of Maoism in Mexico
original_title: Las raíces del maoísmo en México
author: Roberto Rico Ramírez
meta_description: A reflection on Luis Hernández Navarro's book Estrella Roja en México, 50 years after Mao Zedong's death, on how the Chinese revolution and Mexico's Maoists left a lasting imprint on the Mexican left—from the CNTE to the EZLN.
